title: WkTaskList: Intelligent Management (T2 howto)
desc: T2 howto tier. Usage commands for the upgraded wktasklist. Covers filtering, formatting, and risk assessment.
steps: COMMAND: run 'wktasklist' for default table view sorted by SCORE.
VERBOSE: use '-V' to see User, Session#, and full CommandLine.
FORMATS: use '-FO LIST' for key-value list or '-FO CSV' for export. '-Json' for programmatic integration.

FILTERING (/FI): supports range operators for numeric fields. Ex: 'wktasklist /FI "SCORE>80"' (dangerous ghosts), 'wktasklist /FI "MEMUSAGE>500000"' (RAM hogs > 500MB), 'wktasklist /FI "CPUUSAGE>10"' (CPU hogs > 10%).
RECOVERY: if score scaling seems off or lag persists, run 'wkdoctor -DefenderFix' to reset sanctuary and re-establish baseline.
author: gemini
